annotations.title: Rents, energy ratings, natural risks, local taxes and internet of a French commune

description: For a French commune (by name, INSEE code or position) or département: asking rents per m² (charges included) for flats, small and large flats and houses, with their range (ANIL/DHUP Carte des loyers); the energy ratings (DPE A–G) of its dwellings diagnosed since July 2021 and the share of passoires thermiques (F or G, which may no longer be let: G since 2025, F from 2028), per flats and houses (ADEME); its natural risks: the risks listed by the state (DDRM), natural disaster (CatNat) decrees since 1982, prevention plans, radon potential (Géorisques); its local tax rates (DGFiP, in %): taxe foncière on buildings and on land, the household waste tax (TEOM; null where a fee pays for it), taxe d'habitation (on second homes and vacant dwellings only since 2023) with the commune's surcharge on second homes, the latest year's and the first's, the taxe foncière year by year, and for a commune how each rate splits between the commune, its syndicates, its intercommunality (named), special taxes and GEMAPI; its median price per m² of recorded sales (DVF) for flats, houses and both over the latest two years against the two before, and year by year; its home internet (ARCEP Ma connexion internet): the share of premises fibre, cable, copper DSL (copper_closed: no new subscribers), fixed 4G, radio and satellite reach, the share getting 8 and 30 Mbit/s and 1 Gbit/s by wire, and its premises by best technology; each mobile operator's 4G coverage of its homes (Orange, SFR, Bouygues Telecom, Free Mobile: the share of homes at each level of ARCEP's simulated maps, very good meaning indoors; metropolitan France), and their antennas in the commune (sites with 4G, 5G, 5G at 3.5 GHz). Each compared with its département and France.

address.description: Street address with its postcode or city (e.g. "17 rue Gambey, 75011 Paris"), located where its sales were recorded (else its street's). Ignored when lat and lng are given.

commune.description: Commune name or INSEE code (e.g. "Carnac", "56034"), or a département code ("56").

place.description: City, city start or postcode (e.g. "Carnac", "Paris 11e", "75011"); with address, the place it is in. Ignored when lat and lng are given.
